title: Cluster ChatToolExecutionContext's 15 fields into cohesive sub-contexts
description:
Audit #9, candidate 9 - Speculative. Sequence WITH TSK-0284 (removes the concrete CodeSearch field) and TSK-0276 Phase 3 (evolves the delegation fields); do not start before those shapes are known.

### Problem
ChatToolExecutionContext (ChatToolCatalog.cs 33-62) is the implicit interface of all 22 catalog tools: 15 fields spanning data access (Memories, Pages, Tasks, CodeSearch - concrete class, Vars), caller identity (Transport, User, CurrentUser, Auth, DefaultPageMinimumRole), write governance (AgentWritesEnabled, AgentWriteAutoAccept), and delegation (NestingDepth, ParentSessionId, InheritedGpuSlot). A tool needing two fields receives fifteen; widening for one tool touches every construction site (MemoryChatAgent, McpController, AgentSessionService).

### Approach
Group fields into sub-context records (data access / caller identity / write governance / delegation) keeping the outer record as a thin composition; or pass narrowed contexts per tool risk tier. Decide during grilling - this card intentionally defers interface design.

### Acceptance criteria
- No tool receives services it does not use beyond its cluster
- Construction sites shrink or stay equal in size; suite green
- Permission helper methods (CanViewPage etc.) keep working unchanged
